description: This file defines an Android activity named DateWidgets2, which displays a TimePicker widget for user to select a time, and updates a TextView with the selected time in HH:MM format.

classes.name: DateWidgets2
classes.description: Android activity that provides a TimePicker for user to select a time and displays it in a TextView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, configures the TimePicker, and sets up the listener for time changes.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the TextView to show the selected time in HH:MM format.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Formats an integer hour or minute as a two-digit string, adding a leading zero if necessary.
